about: Change the data on an establishment card, such as the trade name, owner or partners.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Open to government entities, private companies and free zone establishments
documents: Preliminary approval when adding a partner or changing activity
Letter from the authorised person asking for the changes
fees: Changing or adding an electronic service 200 AED
Fine 1,000 AED for changing details without telling ICP
channels: ICP Smart Services website (sign in with UAE PASS)
